title: rosa canina subvar. eriostyla
intro: Rosa canina subvar. eriostyla, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose, is a small, deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help reduce symptoms of digestive issues, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. eriostyla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and free radical scavenging activities. The plant's extracts have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various conditions, including inflammation, oxidative stress, and microbial infections.
